description: How many applications the account has left and has sent today (or unlimited), and anything stopping applications from being sent. Reads only.
name: get_account

applications.description: The allowance the sender counts against.

daily_remaining.description: Applications left today; null when unlimited.

limit.description: This week's allowance; null when unlimited.

month_limit.description: This month's allowance; null when unlimited.

month_remaining.description: Applications left this month; null when unlimited.

remaining.description: Applications left this week; null when unlimited.

resets_at.description: When the week's allowance resets, ISO 8601; null when unlimited.

unlimited.description: True for an account with no weekly, daily or monthly cap.

send_blockers.description: Everything that stops applications from being sent now, in words.

title: Read application usage
